entries.title: The Five Piano Concertos
entries.finding: Five concertos and three solo variation cycles are present. The solo cycles have Gilels but no Szell/Cleveland; the source gives no exact work-scoped conductor/orchestra assignments accepted by current rules. G182/WoO71 and G191/WoO80 need explicit source-catalogue reconciliation, including theme/variation spans. Do not demand orchestral players in piano solos, but do not silently invent their source scopes either.
